results.title: Corps members applaud FG, NADDC over CNG retrofitting training
results.description: Youth corps members in Abuja, Lagos and Enugu have applauded the Federal Government and the National Automotive Design and Development Council (NADDC) for introducing technical capacity-building training in Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) vehicle conversion and retrofitting. results.title: NASA's Curiosity Rover Ignites Alien Rumours After Capturing an Unexplained 'Tripod-Like Object'
results.description: A mysterious tripod-like object captured by NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars has sparked debate about extraterrestrial life, though experts suggest it may be a camera artefact.

results.title: Bajaj Pulsar 125 and Pulsar 150 to Debut on August 24: Here’s What The New Bikes May Offer
results.description: Bajaj Auto is expected to reveal the prices of the new Pulsar 125 and Pulsar 150 on August 24. With upgrades including TFT instrumentation, monoshock suspension, LED lighting and revised engines, both models could be priced slightly above their respective outgoing versions. The new Pulsar 125 is expected to receive a substantial makeover, with spy images revealing a redesigned LED headlamp, refreshed tail lamp and revised tank extensions. The motorcycle is also likely to feature a new exhaust system and sharper graphics, giving it a more modern and sporty appearance.
